items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Years ago I played with Budd.

ctx.x: All I have to do is walk across the bridge. From where I live it's about, maybe, four or five blocks, and catch the subway and ride to the last stop.
Do you ever play with Budd Johnson?
Years ago I played with Budd. But, I usually -- when I'm in California, I usually play with Joe Williams,
